title: Amazon Just Lost 40 Leo Satellites. The Bigger Problem Is the Rocket It Booked 38 Launches On
summary: Forty satellites vanished in minutes, yet Wall Street barely blinked. The real damage sits in a launch schedule with few backup rockets, a 2029 regulatory clock, and a rival that happens to be one of Amazon's own launch providers.

title: Nobody can replace Jensen Huang. What that means for AI
summary: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia after a week of alleged spy ties, reported affairs and a resignation, with about $2 trillion gone from Nvidia's value. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why he was a one-of-one founder, who might replace him, the rivals circling Nvidia and why a China chip ban could backfire.

title: US Administration Plans AI National Champions Programme Including Nvidia, Amazon and Microsoft, WSJ Reports
summary: The Trump administration is preparing to designate more than two dozen technology companies as artificial intelligence “national champions” under a proposed programme intended to support their international expansion, according to a report published by The Wall Street Journal on Sunday. Companies reportedly under consideration include Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN), Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT), OpenAI (NASDAQ:OAI) and Anthropic (NASDAQ:ANT).
